segments.name: rental operations
segments.description: Owns, operates and redevelops self storage properties in the United States, renting storage units to residential and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has a single operating segment: rental operations which reflects the aggregated rental operations from our same-store portfolio consisting of only those stores owned and operated on a stabilized basis at the beginning and at the end of the applicable periods presented.

revenueModel.text: Residential and commercial customers rent storage units at the company's self storage stores, which produces rental revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Rental revenues are significantly influenced by demand for self storage space generally, and a decrease in such demand would likely have a greater adverse effect on our rental revenues than if we owned a more diversified real estate portfolio or if we owned a larger number of self storage properties.
